parties: Kimbal Private Limited (investee); GEF Capital Partners, Niveshaay Sambhav Fund (investors)
headline: Trilegal acts on Kimbal $22 million Series B fundraise
sum: Kimbal Private Limited, a smart metering and energy transition technology company, closed a $22 million Series B round led by GEF Capital Partners with co-investment from Niveshaay Sambhav Fund. The capital will fund product development in power quality, energy management, battery storage, AMI scaling, manufacturing and international expansion.
implication: Structured equity fundraise by domestic deep-tech company in distributed energy management space; typical Series B investor syndication model with lead and co-investor participation.
detail: Kimbal, founded in 2011 by Ayush Sinhal, provides smart metering and energy transition solutions with focus on Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) and battery storage. The Series B capital targets product development across power quality, energy management and battery storage solutions, enhancement of AMI and manufacturing capabilities, and geographic expansion beyond India. Trilegal's Corporate Practice team (led by Partner Sanjam Arora) and Capital Markets team (led by Partner Vijay Parthasarathi) advised on the transaction.
